title: Italy: a kingdom before Rome
hook: Was Rome part of the new kingdom from its first day?

knows: Events happen in places and at different times.

objective: The kingdom existed before Rome joined it.

claims.text: Before 1861: Fragmented peninsula. The peninsula contains separate states.
claims.source: https://history.state.gov/countries/italy/summary — Political fragmentation, 1861 kingdom; Papal States page for 1870 and 1871; https://history.state.gov/countries/papal-states — Incorporation into Italy and move of capital

claims.text: 1861: Kingdom. Most of the peninsula forms a kingdom.
claims.source: https://history.state.gov/countries/italy/summary — Political fragmentation, 1861 kingdom; Papal States page for 1870 and 1871; https://history.state.gov/countries/papal-states — Incorporation into Italy and move of capital

claims.text: 1870: Rome incorporated. Rome joins the Kingdom of Italy.
claims.source: https://history.state.gov/countries/italy/summary — Political fragmentation, 1861 kingdom; Papal States page for 1870 and 1871; https://history.state.gov/countries/papal-states — Incorporation into Italy and move of capital

claims.text: 1871: Capital moves. The capital moves to Rome.
claims.source: https://history.state.gov/countries/italy/summary — Political fragmentation, 1861 kingdom; Papal States page for 1870 and 1871; https://history.state.gov/countries/papal-states — Incorporation into Italy and move of capital

claims.text: The kingdom existed before Rome joined it. Most of the peninsula unified in 1861, Rome was incorporated in 1870, and the capital moved there in 1871. State formation and the choice of capital were separate steps, not one event.
claims.source: https://history.state.gov/countries/italy/summary — Political fragmentation, 1861 kingdom; Papal States page for 1870 and 1871; https://history.state.gov/countries/papal-states — Incorporation into Italy and move of capital

recall.question: When the kingdom formed in 1861, was Rome included?
recall.why: The kingdom existed before Rome joined it. Most of the peninsula unified in 1861, Rome was incorporated in 1870, and the capital moved there in 1871. State formation and the choice of capital were separate steps, not one event.
